events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with the US showing military strength but also its waning geopolitical power. This has led to a surge in gold prices and a potential shift in the global balance of power.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund (UUP)

events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war is likely to lead to increased volatility in the markets, with gold serving as a safe haven. The US dollar may weaken as a result of the geopolitical tensions.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for a potential US-Iran peace deal

events.exitStrategy: Exit when gold prices drop below $1800/oz or when a peace deal is announced

events.title: US Inflation Rate
events.summary: The US inflation rate has hit a 3-year high, with the Federal Reserve holding interest rates steady. This has led to a decrease in the US dollar and an increase in gold prices.

actions.label: BUY
actions.target: iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG)

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: Invesco PowerShares DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund (UUP)

events.reasoning: The high inflation rate may lead to a decrease in the US dollar and an increase in bond prices. The Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady may also lead to a decrease in the US dollar.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for the next Federal Reserve meeting

events.exitStrategy: Exit when the US inflation rate drops below 2% or when the Federal Reserve raises interest rates

gains.conservativeNote: If the inflation rate remains steady
gains.extendedNote: If the inflation rate increases further

events.title: NVIDIA AI Semiconductor Stocks
events.summary: NVIDIA's AI chip sales in China have stalled, with local chipmakers like Huawei taking the lead. This has led to a decrease in NVIDIA's stock price.
events.reasoning: The stall in NVIDIA's AI chip sales in China may lead to a decrease in its stock price. Marvell Technology Group Ltd. may benefit from the trend towards AI semiconductor stocks.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for NVIDIA's next earnings report

events.exitStrategy: Exit when NVIDIA's stock price increases above $500 or when Marvell's stock price drops below $40

gains.conservativeNote: If the trend towards AI semiconductor stocks continues
gains.extendedNote: If NVIDIA's AI chip sales in China recover
